name: Public Health and Environment
description: Introduction to public health concepts relevant to environmental engineering. Exposure pathways, dose-response relationships, epidemiological study designs, risk assessment methods, and basic biostatistics. Application of engineering tools to analyze air and water quality data, model health risks, and evaluate environmental interventions. Case studies—drawn from historical events, contemporary issues, and global and Indian contexts—are used illustratively and may vary. Activities include case analysis, op-ed writing, and development of a public health impact assessment.
